amount.description: slide: distance in pixels; scale: factor at the far end; push_in and pull_out: zoom factor. Per preset default.

direction.description: slide only: the side it comes from or leaves to. Default left.

duration.description: A length, at most the item's duration. Default 0.5s; the whole item for push_in and pull_out.

edge.description: in animates the start of the item, out its end. Default in.

item_id.description: A clip, text, caption or shape item.

description: Writes ordinary keyframes (with a Bezier easing where the preset needs a curve) on the first duration frames (edge in) or the last ones (edge out) of a clip, text, caption or shape item; edit them afterwards with keyframe.set and keyframe.set_easing. Keyframes of the same properties inside that window are replaced, the rest are kept. duration is at most the item's duration, default 0.5s (the whole item for push_in and pull_out). direction is for slide; amount is the slide distance in pixels, the scale factor of scale, or the zoom factor of push_in and pull_out. animation.list_presets describes them.
name: animation.apply_preset
summary: Animates the start or end of a visual item with a preset: fade, slide, scale, pop, push in or pull out.

description: Changes nothing. The result lists, for each preset of animation.apply_preset, what it animates and the range and default of its parameters, and the four numbers of each named curve of keyframe.set_easing.
name: animation.list_presets
summary: Describes the animation presets and the named Bezier curves.

asset.description: An Asset object of SDD-001 section 3.2.

description: Adds the asset with the facts measured on the normalized media. An asset whose hash is already in the project is not added again: its identifier is returned in effective.asset_id. Only the import flow issues it.
name: asset.add
summary: Adds an asset that the import flow has already ingested.

asset_id.description: The id of the asset to remove.

description: Removes the asset from the project. It fails with E_IN_USE, listing the items, while an item uses it. The file stays in the content store.
name: asset.remove
summary: Removes an asset that no item uses.

asset_id.description: An audio asset, a video asset with audio, or ast_placeholder in a template.

duration.description: A length; default the rest of the asset.

start.description: Absolute position; omitted, the end of the last item of the track (0s on an empty track).

description: Adds an audio item. The default duration is the rest of the asset from source_in. The reserved asset ast_placeholder creates a template slot holder and needs an explicit duration.
name: audio.add
summary: Places an audio asset, or the audio of a video asset, on an audio track.

item_id.description: A clip or audio item; give this or track_id.

track_id.description: A track; give this or item_id.

description: Replaces the chain of an item or a track with a preset: voice, voice_with_music, podcast or clean_noisy_room. The chain becomes exactly the preset; change any processor afterwards with audio.processor_set. voice_with_music has no noise reduction.
name: audio.apply_preset
summary: Preset

attack.description: A length, may be 0; the ramp down before speech. Default "0.2s".

gain_db.description: Change of volume while speech sounds, -40 to -1; default -12.

item_id.description: The music: an audio item with no volume keyframes.

release.description: A length, may be 0; the ramp up after speech. Default "0.5s".

speech_item_ids.description: Clips or audio items that carry the speech.

description: Writes volume keyframes on the music item: its volume drops by gain_db over attack before each stretch of speech and returns over release after it. Speech stretches closer than the ramps are held low across the gap. The speech comes from the analysis of the speech items and is supplied by the service in resolved; the command never starts a job. The item must have no volume keyframes yet; keyframe.clear on volume undoes the ducking.
name: audio.duck
summary: Lowers a music item while speech sounds, with a ramp down before and a ramp up after.

bpm.description: Manual tempo in beats per minute, 20 to 400, for music whose pulse the analysis cannot find; replaces the detected grid.

every.description: Mark every nth beat of the visible part, from the first; default 1.

item_id.description: An audio item of an audio asset, or of a video asset with audio.

label.description: Label of every marker, up to 60 characters; default none.

offset.description: With bpm: the time of the first beat on the asset's time axis, from its start; default "0s".

replace.description: true (default) replaces the item's markers; false keeps them and adds the beats.

description: Places a marker at each beat of the visible part of the item, or at every nth beat, so that cuts and transitions can be aligned to the music. Beats are frames of the asset and come from the beat grid of the asset, supplied by the service in resolved; the command never starts a job. Markers have no effect on the picture or the sound. When the analysis finds no steady pulse, give bpm (and offset, the time of the first beat on the asset's own time axis, default 0) and the beats are those of that tempo; the grid of the asset is then not used, for example {"item_id": "itm_s6t7v8w9x0", "bpm": 120, "offset": "0.25s"}.
name: audio.mark_beats
summary: Writes markers on a music item at the beats of its audio.

enabled.description: false adds it switched off; default true.

index.description: Where to insert, 0 to the length of the chain; default the end.

item_id.description: A clip or audio item; give this or track_id.

kind.description: eq, compressor, limiter, gate, deesser or noise_reduction.

params.description: Parameter values by name; the rest keep their default.

track_id.description: A track; give this or item_id.

description: Adds an audio processor to the chain of a clip or audio item (item_id) or of a track (track_id). kind is eq, compressor, limiter, gate, deesser or noise_reduction; params are the values that differ from the default of the kind (units and ranges in SDD-004 7.1). The chain runs in order, so index matters; a track chain runs on the sum of the track.
name: audio.processor_add
summary: Add

item_id.description: A clip or audio item; give this or track_id.

to.description: Its new place, 0 to the length minus one.

track_id.description: A track; give this or item_id.

description: Moves a processor to another place in the chain of an item or a track. index and to are 0-based places in the chain; the order changes the sound.
name: audio.processor_move
summary: Move

item_id.description: A clip or audio item; give this or track_id.

track_id.description: A track; give this or item_id.

description: Removes a processor from the chain of an item or a track. index is the 0-based place in the chain; later processors move one place earlier.
name: audio.processor_remove
summary: Remove

enabled.description: true switches it on, false off.

item_id.description: A clip or audio item; give this or track_id.

params.description: Values to change; the others stay.

track_id.description: A track; give this or item_id.

description: Changes one processor of the chain of an item or a track. index is the 0-based place in the chain. params are merged with the current ones; enabled false keeps the processor but skips it.
name: audio.processor_set
summary: Set

linked_item.description: The clip whose speech this transcribes; it need not exist.

start.description: a time with a unit: "12.5s", "375f" or "00:00:12.500"

text.description: Text to split on whitespace; needs duration.

track_id.description: A visual track; omitted, the highest visual track free over the item (an empty track you made for video counts; pass track_id to keep it clear), or a new one on top. effective.track_id names it.

words.description: Words with times relative to the caption, as lengths.

duration.description: a time with a unit: "12.5s", "375f" or "00:00:12.500"

start.description: a time with a unit: "12.5s", "375f" or "00:00:12.500"

description: Adds a caption. Give either words (times relative to the caption, as lengths) or text with a duration: the text is split on whitespace and the words share the duration in proportion to their character counts. x and y are used when the caption style position of the track is custom.
name: caption.add
summary: Adds a caption item with timed words.

text.description: The new text, 0 to 80 characters, no whitespace; empty removes.

description: Replaces the text of the word at index; timing is untouched. An empty text removes the word and leaves a gap. The only word of a caption cannot be removed.
name: caption.edit_word
summary: Changes the text of one word of a caption, or removes the word.

clip_item_id.description: A clip of a video asset with audio, or an audio item.

max_gap.description: A length, may be 0; a longer pause starts a caption. Default "0.6s".

new_ids.description: Ids for the created captions, in order.

replace.description: Remove the captions linked to this clip on this track first. Default true.

track_id.description: A visual track that receives the captions.

description: Groups the transcript words of the visible range of the clip into captions of at most max_words words and max_chars characters, split at pauses longer than max_gap, and links them to the clip. With replace (the default) the captions already linked to the clip on that track are removed first. The transcript is supplied by the service in resolved; the command never starts a job.
name: caption.from_transcript
summary: Creates captions for the speech of a clip from its transcript.

format.description: srt or vtt; default: vtt when the text starts with WEBVTT.

new_ids.description: Ids for the created captions, in cue order.

start.description: A length added to every cue; default 0.

text.description: The SRT or WebVTT text itself, not a file path: read the file and pass its content.

track_id.description: A visual track that receives the captions.

description: Reads the subtitle text, never a file path (the caller reads the file and sends its content), and adds one caption for each cue on a visual track: the cue time is the caption time, rounded to frames, and its words share the duration in proportion to their character counts. Markup tags and line breaks are dropped. start moves every cue later by that length. The cues must not overlap each other or the items of the track.
name: caption.import_subtitles
summary: Creates one caption per cue of an SRT or WebVTT text.

item_ids.description: Exactly two distinct captions of one track, in any order.

description: The caption that starts first keeps its identifier, style and position and takes the words of the other; the other is removed. Captions with keyframes cannot be merged.
name: caption.merge
summary: Joins two captions of one track into one that spans both.

clip_item_id.description: A clip of a video asset with audio, or an audio item.

description: Maps the transcript words of the visible range to the timeline again and gives them to the linked captions in order, each taking as many words as it has. Edited texts are kept when the word count is unchanged. The transcript is supplied by the service in resolved.
name: caption.retime_from_clip
summary: Retimes the captions linked to a clip after the clip was moved, trimmed or sped up.

breaks.description: Indexes of the words that start a new line, strictly increasing; [] clears.

description: Each break is the index of the word that starts a new line, from 1 to the word count minus 1, strictly increasing. An empty array clears the breaks.
name: caption.set_breaks
summary: Sets the forced line breaks of a caption.

replace.description: Replace the whole override with style instead of merging.

style.description: A partial CaptionStyle merged into the override (null removes a key), or null or {} to clear it.

description: The given keys are merged into the override the caption already has, so a later call that gives only a colour keeps the position set before; a null value removes one key. With replace true the object replaces the whole override. A null or {} style clears the override. highlight is none or word. The caption style of the track is not touched.
name: caption.set_style
summary: Sets, changes or clears the style override of one caption.

duration.description: A length. With words: at least the end of the last word, default that end. With text: default the current duration.

text.description: Text split on whitespace and spread over the duration; instead of words.

words.description: 1 to 60 words with times relative to the caption, as lengths. Or give text.

duration.description: a time with a unit: "12.5s", "375f" or "00:00:12.500"

start.description: a time with a unit: "12.5s", "375f" or "00:00:12.500"

description: Replaces all words, given as words (1 to 60, times relative to the caption, as lengths) or as text, which is split on whitespace and spread over the caption's current duration like caption.add (duration may change it). With words the caption lasts until the end of the last word unless duration is given. Line breaks are cleared; keyframes are cut when the caption gets shorter.
name: caption.set_words
summary: Replaces the words of a caption.

before_word.description: Index of the first word of the right part.

new_id.description: The id of the right part.

description: The right part starts with the word at before_word. Style and the linked clip are copied to it; transition_out moves to it. The cut falls at the start of that word, so the parts cover the original range.
name: caption.split
summary: Splits a caption into two at a word boundary.

asset_id.description: A video or image asset, or ast_placeholder in a template.

duration.description: A length; default the rest of the asset, or 5s for an image.

source_in.description: Offset into the asset; default 0s; omit for an image.

start.description: Absolute position; omitted, the end of the last item of the track (0s on an empty track).

description: Adds a clip. The default duration is the rest of the asset from source_in, or 5 seconds for an image. The reserved asset ast_placeholder creates a template slot holder and needs an explicit duration.
name: clip.add
summary: Places a video or image asset on a visual track.

duration.description: A length; default the rest of the nested timeline from source_in.

source_in.description: Where in the nested timeline to start, as a length from its start; default 0s.

start.description: Absolute position; omitted, the end of the last item of the track (0s on an empty track).

timeline_id.description: Another timeline of the same project.

description: Adds a composition: the timeline named by timeline_id, used as a clip (RF-083). Nothing is copied, so changing that timeline changes every composition that uses it. The default duration is the rest of the nested timeline from source_in. A timeline cannot contain itself at any depth, and compositions nest at most 4 deep.
name: clip.add_composition
summary: Places another timeline of the project on a visual track as one clip.

item_id.description: A clip of a video asset with audio, or an audio item.

min_silence.description: A length; shorter silences are ignored. Default "0.4s".

new_ids.description: Ids for the second, third, ... pieces, in order.

padding.description: A length, may be 0; speech kept around each cut. Default "0.1s".

description: Replaces the clip or audio item by one item per non-silent stretch of its source range. Silences shorter than min_silence are kept; padding of speech is kept on each side of a cut. With ripple track the pieces close up and the later items of the track follow. The silences come from the analysis of the asset and are supplied by the service in resolved; the command never starts a job. Captions linked to the clip move their link to the piece that holds their first word.
name: clip.remove_silences
summary: Cuts the silences out of a clip or audio item, one item per stretch of speech.

asset_id.description: A video or image asset of the document, of the same kind as the clip's asset.

description: Replaces the asset a clip plays, a video by a video or an image by an image, and keeps its position, duration, trim, speed, transform, keyframes and effects: the animation an external engine rendered again takes the place of the one it replaces. Nothing is stretched or trimmed: a video the clip's range does not fit is refused.
name: clip.replace_media
summary: Swaps the asset of a clip for another of the same kind and keeps everything else.

mode.description: normal, multiply, screen, overlay or add.

description: Sets one blend mode of the fixed list (normal, multiply, screen, overlay, add). normal is the default and clears the stored one. Works on clip, text, caption and shape items.
name: clip.set_blend
summary: Sets how a visual item is mixed with what is below it.

item_id.description: A clip, text, caption or shape item.

radius.description: Blur radius in pixels, 0 to 100; 0 removes the blur.

description: Sets the Gaussian blur radius in pixels at project resolution, 0 to 100; 0 removes the blur.
name: clip.set_blur
summary: Sets the blur radius of a visual item.

color.description: The colour to remove, #RRGGBB, or null to remove the key.

similarity.description: 0 to 1; default 0.3, or the current value.

smoothness.description: 0 to 1; default 0.1, or the current value.

spill.description: 0 to 1; default 0, or the current value.

description: Makes the pixels near a colour transparent. similarity (0 to 1, default 0.3) is how far from the colour a pixel is still removed, smoothness (0 to 1, default 0.1) the soft edge beyond it and spill (0 to 1, default 0) how much of the colour is taken out of the pixels that stay. On a clip that is already keyed, values not given keep their current value. color null removes the key. Values are rounded to 3 decimals.
name: clip.set_chroma_key
summary: Keys out one colour of a clip, such as a green screen.

curves.description: Tone curves: master, red, green, blue.

blue.description: As master, for the blue channel.

green.description: As master, for the green channel.

master.description: 2 to 8 points, x strictly increasing; [] or the line (0,0)-(1,1) removes the curve.

red.description: As master, for the red channel.

hsl.description: Bands of colour ranges, up to 8; a given range replaces its band, a neutral band removes it.

hue.description: Shift of the hue, -1 to 1 (30 degrees each way); default 0.

lut_asset.description: Id of a lut asset to grade the clip with.

lut_intensity.description: 0 to 1; default 1; 0 removes the lookup table.

wheels.description: Colour wheels of shadows, midtones and highlights.

amount.description: Strength of the tint, 0 to 1; default 0.

hue.description: Direction of the tint in degrees, 0 red, 120 green, 240 blue; default 0.

luma.description: Lifts or lowers the range, -1 to 1; default 0.

amount.description: Strength of the tint, 0 to 1; default 0.

hue.description: Direction of the tint in degrees, 0 red, 120 green, 240 blue; default 0.

luma.description: Lifts or lowers the range, -1 to 1; default 0.

shadows.description: Replaces the wheel; a neutral wheel (amount 0, luma 0) removes it.

amount.description: Strength of the tint, 0 to 1; default 0.

hue.description: Direction of the tint in degrees, 0 red, 120 green, 240 blue; default 0.

luma.description: Lifts or lowers the range, -1 to 1; default 0.

description: Sets the given adjustments, rounded to 3 decimals; a value equal to the default (brightness 0, contrast 1, saturation 1, temperature 0, tint 0, hue 0) clears the stored one. Positive temperature is warmer, positive tint is more magenta, hue rotates the colours in degrees. lut_asset is the id of a lut asset (a .cube file) and lut_intensity how much of it is mixed in, 0 to 1, default 1; lut_intensity 0 removes the lookup table. hsl bands (red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, magenta: hue, saturation, lightness, -1 to 1), wheels (shadows, midtones, highlights: hue 0 to 360, amount 0 to 1, luma -1 to 1) and curves (master, red, green, blue: 2 to 8 points of x and y from 0 to 1) each replace what they name and a neutral one removes it.
name: clip.set_color
summary: Sets brightness, contrast, saturation, temperature, tint, hue, LUT, HSL bands, wheels and curves of a clip.

effects.description: The effects in order, up to 6, each kind once; [] removes them all.

angle.description: Direction in degrees, -180 to 180; motion_blur, rgb_split.

radius.description: Spread in frame pixels, 1 to 100; glow.

size.description: Grain size in frame pixels, 1 to 8; grain.

softness.description: How far in the darkening starts, 0 to 1; vignette.

threshold.description: Brightness where the glow starts, 0 to 1; glow.

description: Replaces the whole list of effects, applied in order; an empty list removes them. Each kind appears at most once and takes only its own parameters (omitted ones get the defaults): motion_blur amount 0.5 and angle 0; glow amount 0.5, radius 12 and threshold 0.6; vignette amount 0.5 and softness 0.5; grain amount 0.3, size 1 and seed 0; rgb_split amount 0.3 and angle 0; shake amount 0.3, speed 8 and seed 0.
name: clip.set_effects
summary: Sets the effects of a clip: motion blur, glow, vignette, grain, RGB split and shake.

filter.description: none (default), grayscale, sepia, invert, warm or cool.

item_id.description: A clip, text, caption or shape item.

description: Sets one filter of the fixed list (none, grayscale, sepia, invert, warm, cool) and its amount, 0 (the original) to 1 (the full filter), rounded to 3 decimals; a value equal to the default (none, 1) clears the stored one.
name: clip.set_filter
summary: Sets the colour filter of a visual item and how much of it is mixed in.

description: Sets the mirror of an item: horizontal flips left to right, vertical flips top to bottom. A side not given keeps its value; false clears it. Works on clip, text, caption and shape items.
name: clip.set_flip
summary: Mirrors a visual item horizontally, vertically or both.

crop.description: Sides to crop, fractions 0 to 1; sides not given keep their value.

description: Sets fit (cover, contain or none) and merges the given crop sides with the current ones. Each side is a fraction of the asset from 0 to 1; left plus right and top plus bottom must stay below 1. A side that has keyframes (crop_left, crop_top, crop_right, crop_bottom; see keyframe.set) cannot be set here.
name: clip.set_framing
summary: Sets how a clip fits the frame and how much of each side is cropped.

mask.description: The mask, or null to remove it.

height.description: A fraction of the item height.

invert.description: Keep the outside of the shape instead; default false.

width.description: A fraction of the item width.

x.description: Left edge, a fraction of the item width.

y.description: Top edge, a fraction of the item height.

description: Sets a mask in the item's own frame: x, y, width and height are fractions of the item (0 to 1, x plus width and y plus height at most 1), feather is the soft edge in pixels (0 to 200, default 0) and invert keeps the outside instead. Replaces the current mask and clears its keyframes (mask_x, mask_y, mask_width, mask_height, mask_feather; see keyframe.set). Works on clip, text, caption and shape items. mask null removes it.
name: clip.set_mask
summary: Limits where a visual item is drawn to a rectangle or an ellipse.

outline.description: The outline, or null to remove it.

description: Sets a contour of width pixels (0.5 to 100, default 4) in color (default #000000) around the visible shape of the clip, so a keyed subject gets a sticker-like border. Width is in project pixels. Replaces the current outline; outline null removes it. Works on clips and still images.
name: clip.set_outline
summary: Gives a clip an outline that follows its visible shape.

shadow.description: The shadow, or null to remove it.

description: Sets a shadow drawn below the clip: the silhouette of its picture (a keyed subject keeps its cut-out shape) in color (default #000000), at opacity (0 to 1, default 0.5), moved by dx and dy pixels (-500 to 500, default 8) and softened by blur pixels (0 to 100, default 12). Lengths are project pixels. Replaces the current shadow; shadow null removes it. Works on clips and still images.
name: clip.set_shadow
summary: Gives a clip a drop shadow that follows its visible shape.

curve.description: Speed ramp: 2 to 8 points, linear between them, first t 0 and last t 1. Not with speed.

speed.description: Text like "0.5x" (up to 3 decimals, 1/4 to 4), never a bare number.

t.description: Position in the item, 0 to 1, up to 3 decimals.

item_id.description: A clip of a video asset, an audio item, or a composition item.

reverse.description: true plays the source range backwards; false plays it forwards.

ripple.description: none (default) or track: shift the later items of the track.

speed.description: "1.5x" (up to 3 decimals) or {"num": 3, "den": 2}; 1/4 to 4. Not with curve.

description: Sets either speed, from 0.25x to 4x, or curve, 2 to 8 points {t, speed} (speed is text like "0.5x") with t the fraction of the item from 0 to 1 (first 0, last 1) and a linear ramp between points; a speed clears the curve. Rescales the duration, the fades, the transitions and the keyframes by the ratio of the old to the new mean speed. With ripple track the later items of the track follow the change in length. Captions linked to the clip are listed, not changed. reverse true plays the same source range backwards (false restores it), alone or with a speed or a curve. A composition item takes a constant speed only: a curve or a reverse on it is refused.
name: clip.set_speed
summary: Changes the speed of a clip or audio item, constant or along a curve, or plays it backwards.

id.description: The id of the composition item.

item_ids.description: The items to move, each once.

name.description: The name of the new timeline; default Composition.

timeline_id.description: The id of the new timeline.

description: Makes a new timeline of the project from the selected items (same tracks, same frame size and rate, starting at frame 0) and replaces them with one composition of it, on the top-most visual track of the selection, for the same frames. The inverse puts the items back; the new timeline stays in the project.
name: composition.create_from_selection
summary: Moves the selected items into a new timeline and puts one composition clip in their place.

description: The inverse of composition.create_from_selection, for a composition that only places its timeline: no opacity, mask, effect, transform, keyframe, transition, blend or volume of its own, the whole timeline shown, and the same frame size and rate. The nested timeline stays in the project.
name: composition.expand
summary: Puts the items of a composition's timeline back on this timeline in place of the composition.

family.description: 1 to 60 characters: letters, digits, space, dot, hyphen, underscore; not a bundled family.

files.description: One file per weight, 1 to 9; a weight appears once.

hash.description: sha256: and 64 lower-case hex characters; a font stored by media import of the workspace.

description: Names a font that is already stored by hash in the workspace as a family of the project, so that styles can use it. The family name must not be a bundled family. Adding to an existing family adds the weights and replaces the file of a weight it already has. The command never reads or stores a file; the service refuses a hash that the workspace does not hold.
name: font.add
summary: Adds a user font family to the project, or more weights to one it already has.

family.description: A user family of the project.

description: Removes the family from the fonts of the project. A family that a text style, a caption style or a track still uses cannot be removed. The font files stay in the workspace.
name: font.remove
summary: Removes a user font family from the project.

duration.description: Length of the crossfade, at least 1 frame.

track_id.description: Only for two neighbours that touch on one track: another visual track the arriving item moves to.

description: The item that leaves gets a fade transition out and the item that arrives a fade transition in, both of the given length, plus the matching audio fades for clips. The two items must overlap by at least that length, and the arriving item must start after the leaving one. For two neighbours that touch on the same track give track_id, another visual track: the arriving item moves there and starts duration earlier, using the source it has before the cut, so they overlap by duration.
name: item.crossfade
summary: Sets a matching fade-out and fade-in on two overlapping visual items of different tracks.

description: Removes the items. With ripple track, every later item on each affected track moves earlier by the length freed on that track; with ripple all, every later item on every track moves by the length freed, which requires the deleted items to cover one contiguous range; ripple all also moves the timeline markers after the range earlier by that length and removes those inside it (effective.markers_removed, markers_moved).
name: item.delete
summary: Removes items, and optionally closes the freed space.

start.description: Absolute start of the copy; default the first free position after the source.

track_id.description: The track of the copy; default the source's track.

description: Adds a copy of the item at start, on the same track or another track of the same kind. Keyframes, words and the name are copied; the slot mark is not. Without start the copy goes to the first free position at or after the end of the source on the target track. With start it fails when the copy would overlap an item of the target track.
name: item.duplicate
summary: Copies an item to another position, optionally on another track.

id.description: The id of the new audio item.

item_id.description: A clip of a video asset with audio.

track_id.description: An audio track with room for the item.

description: Adds an audio item on an audio track with the same asset, start, duration, source range, speed, curve, reverse, volume, fades, noise reduction and volume keyframes as the clip, links the two, and sets audio_muted on the clip so the sound is not heard twice.
name: item.extract_audio
summary: Creates an audio item from the audio of a video clip, linked to it, and mutes the clip.

at.description: Absolute frame inside the clip whose picture is held.

duration.description: How long the frame is held; default 3s.

freeze_id.description: Id for the freeze frame item.

item_id.description: A clip of a video asset.

new_id.description: Id for the right part of the split.

description: Splits the clip at a timeline frame and puts between the two parts a new clip that shows the source frame at that point for duration (default 3s), with no sound. The right part and the later items of the track move later by duration; other tracks are untouched. The freeze frame has no keyframes. Not for linked items or items with a speed curve.
name: item.freeze_frame
summary: Holds one frame of a clip: splits the clip at a frame and inserts a still of that frame.

id.description: The id of the link group, lnk_ and 10 characters; generated when omitted.

description: Puts 2 to 20 clip, audio, text or shape items in one link group. item.move, item.trim and item.split on one of them apply the same change to the others, and a locked track refuses the edit that would change a linked item on it. An item belongs to one group; unlink it first to link it elsewhere.
name: item.link
summary: Links items so that they move, trim and split together.

slide.description: Slide edit: the neighbours that touch the item keep touching it, the one before ends and the one after starts where the item now does. Needs start; not with track_id.

start.description: The new absolute position of the first frame.

track_id.description: A track that accepts the item type.

description: Sets the start of the item, its track, or both; at least one is required. Keyframes, words, transitions and fades are relative to the item and travel with it. With slide true the neighbours that touch the item are trimmed so they keep touching it (a slide edit).
name: item.move
summary: Moves an item in time, to another track of the same kind, or both.

attributes.description: Groups to copy: color, filter, blur, framing, transform, blend, mask, flip, chroma_key, effects, audio. At least one, each once.

item_ids.description: The items to copy to, 1 to 20.

description: Copies attribute groups from one item to 1 to 20 others: color, filter, blur, framing, transform (x, y, scale, rotation, opacity), blend, mask, flip, chroma_key, effects, audio (volume, denoise, voice). A group the target type does not have is skipped and listed in effective.skipped. Keyframes are not copied; a target whose animated property would be overwritten is refused.
name: item.paste_attributes
summary: Copies the look of one item to other items.

name.description: The label, 0 to 120 characters; empty clears it.

description: Sets the display name of the item; an empty name clears it.
name: item.rename
summary: Sets the label of an item.

copies.description: How many extra copies to add after the item (2 plays it three times). Give copies or until.

link.description: Link the item and its copies so they move, trim and split together; default false.

new_ids.description: Ids for the copies, in order; the rest are generated.

ripple.description: none (default) or track: the later items of the track move later by the length added.

until.description: Absolute time the sequence ends at; the last copy is trimmed to end there. Give copies or until.

description: Adds copies of the item one after the other on its track, starting at its end: give copies (1 to 200 extra plays) or until (an absolute time; the last copy is trimmed to end exactly there). Keyframes, words and the name are copied; the slot mark is not. With ripple none (default) it fails when a copy would overlap an item of the track; with ripple track the later items of the track move later by the length added. With link the item and its copies are linked, so they move, trim and split together (up to 20 items).
name: item.repeat
summary: Repeats an item back to back, a number of times or until a time, such as a looping background.

audio_muted.description: Drop the audio of a clip.

voice.description: Voice preset: none (default), clear, warm, deep, bright or radio.

description: Sets the given values. Volume 1, fades of 0, audio_muted false, denoise 0 and voice none clear the stored value. audio_muted applies to clip items only. denoise is the noise reduction strength, 0 to 1. voice is a preset for speech: clear, warm, deep, bright or radio. The two fades together cannot be longer than the item.
name: item.set_audio
summary: Sets the volume, fades, mute, noise reduction or voice of a clip or audio item.

enabled.description: false turns the item off, true turns it on.

description: enabled false keeps the item, its place and its settings, and makes the preview, the export and the audio mix ignore it; true turns it back on. Works on every item type.
name: item.set_enabled
summary: Turns an item off or on without removing it from the timeline.

item_id.description: A clip, text, caption or shape item.

scale.description: Uniform scale, greater than 0 and at most 20.

x.description: Centre of the item in pixels.

y.description: Centre of the item in pixels.

description: Sets the given properties, rounded to 3 decimals. Scale 1, rotation 0 and opacity 1 clear the stored value. A property that has keyframes cannot be set; use keyframe.set or keyframe.clear.
name: item.set_transform
summary: Sets the position, scale, rotation or opacity of a visual item.

direction.description: whip and wipe only: left (default), right, up or down.

duration.description: Length of the transition, at least 1 frame; default 0.5s.

item_id.description: A clip, text, caption or shape item.

kind.description: fade, slide_left, slide_right, slide_up, slide_down, zoom, whip, dip, wipe, spin, shrink, grow, or null to remove.

description: Sets a fade, a slide, a zoom, a whip, a dip, a wipe, a spin, a shrink or a grow on the in or out edge, 0.5 seconds long unless duration is given; kind null removes the transition. color (#RRGGBB, default black) is for dip; direction (left, right, up or down, default left) is for whip and wipe. The two transitions together cannot be longer than the item. A transition needs something visible beneath it: to crossfade, let the previous clip run under it, on another track below, so that it is still playing during the duration of the in edge (or already playing during the out edge); otherwise lint reports L_TRANSITION_EMPTY. For example, clip A on the lower track ends at 4.5s and clip B on the upper track starts at 4s, so B gets {"item_id": B, "edge": "in", "kind": "fade", "duration": "0.5s"}.
name: item.set_transition
summary: Sets or removes the transition on one edge of a visual item.

item_id.description: A clip or audio item of a video or audio asset.

source_in.description: The new offset into the asset where the item starts reading.

description: Sets source_in, the offset into the asset where the item starts reading (a slip edit). The start, the duration, the keyframes and the neighbours do not change. The source range must stay inside the asset.
name: item.slip
summary: Shows another part of the source in a clip or audio item without moving or resizing it.

at.description: Absolute position strictly inside the item.

new_id.description: The id of the right part.

new_ids.description: The ids of the right parts of the linked items that the split cuts, in the order of the ids of those items.

description: The original item keeps its id and becomes the left part; a new item is the right part. Transitions, fades, keyframes and caption words are divided so that the motion is unchanged.
name: item.split
summary: Splits an item into two at a timeline frame.

ripple.description: none (default) or track: the later items of the track follow the change in length; with the start edge the item keeps its start.

roll.description: Roll edit: the touching edge of the neighbouring item moves to the same frame, so the cut moves and nothing else changes. Not with ripple track.

to.description: Absolute position of the edge; the end is exclusive.

description: Moves an edge to an absolute position and keeps the source range, the keyframes and the caption words consistent. The end edge is exclusive: it is the first frame after the item. With ripple track the later items of the track follow the change in length (a start trim then keeps the start of the item). With roll true the touching edge of the neighbouring item moves to the same frame (a roll edit).
name: item.trim
summary: Moves the start edge or the end edge of an item to a timeline position.

item_ids.description: The items to take out of their link group.

description: Takes each listed item out of its link group. A group left with one item is dissolved, so the item that remains is unlinked too (listed in effective.also_unlinked).
name: item.unlink
summary: Removes items from their link group.

property.description: One property; default every animated property.

description: The value at the first frame of the item becomes the static value. Without property, every animated property is cleared.
name: keyframe.clear
summary: Removes all keyframes of one property, or of every property.

at.description: Position of the keyframe on the project timeline, from the item start to its end inclusive.

description: Removes the keyframe at the absolute position. The last keyframe of a property writes its value into the static field.
name: keyframe.remove
summary: Removes the keyframe of a property at a frame.

at.description: Position on the project timeline, from the item start to its end inclusive.

bezier.description: x1, y1, x2, y2 of the curve of easing bezier: x1 and x2 from 0 to 1, y1 and y2 from -2 to 3.

easing.description: From this keyframe to the next. Default linear. bezier needs the bezier argument.

value.description: Valid for the property: scale above 0 up to 20, opacity 0 to 1, volume 0 to 4.

description: Sets the value of x, y, scale, rotation, opacity, (clips and audio) volume, (clips) brightness, contrast, saturation, temperature, tint or hue, (items with a mask, set it first with clip.set_mask) mask_x, mask_y, mask_width, mask_height or mask_feather, or (clips) crop_left, crop_top, crop_right or crop_bottom at an absolute position inside the item, from its start to its end inclusive. When the property had no keyframe and at is after the start, its current static value becomes the first keyframe. The easing applies from this keyframe to the next. At most 100 keyframes per property.
name: keyframe.set
summary: Adds or replaces a keyframe of one animated property of an item.

at.description: Position of an existing keyframe on the project timeline.

bezier.description: x1, y1, x2, y2 of a cubic Bezier curve: x1 and x2 from 0 to 1, y1 and y2 from -2 to 3.

easing.description: A named easing. Exactly one of easing, bezier and preset.

preset.description: A named Bezier curve, stored as its four numbers.

description: Gives the keyframe at the absolute position a named easing (easing), a custom cubic Bezier curve (bezier: x1, y1, x2, y2; x1 and x2 from 0 to 1, y1 and y2 from -2 to 3) or a named Bezier preset (preset: in, out, in_out, back, overshoot, stored as its four numbers). Exactly one of the three. The value and the time of the keyframe do not change. Works for every animatable property, crop and mask included.
name: keyframe.set_easing
summary: Changes the easing of the segment that starts at a keyframe.

item_id.description: An item to mark instead of the timeline; at must then fall inside it.

description: Adds a marker at a frame of the timeline, with an optional label of up to 60 characters. With item_id the marker belongs to that item (at must fall inside it) and moves with it, like the beat markers of audio.mark_beats. At most 200 markers on the timeline and on each item; one marker per frame. Markers have no effect on the picture or the sound.
name: marker.add
summary: Puts a marker on the timeline, or on one item.

all.description: true removes every marker, instead of at.

at.description: The position of the marker to remove.

item_id.description: The item that holds the marker; all then clears its markers.

description: Removes the marker at a frame; all removes every marker. With item_id it works on the markers of that item, beat markers included.
name: marker.remove
summary: Removes a marker of the timeline or of an item.

at.description: The position of the marker to change.

item_id.description: The item that holds the marker; at and to fall inside it.

label.description: The new label, up to 60 characters; "" removes it.

description: Finds the marker at a frame and changes its frame (to) and or its label; a label of "" removes the label. With item_id it works on the markers of that item, and at and to fall inside it.
name: marker.set
summary: Moves or relabels a marker of the timeline or of an item.

description: Sets the name of the project. The name is stored exactly as given, without trimming.
name: project.rename
summary: Sets the project name.

aspect.description: A preset frame size, or give width and height.

description: Sets the frame size from an aspect preset (16:9 is 1920x1080, 9:16 is 1080x1920, 1:1 is 1080x1080, 4:5 is 1080x1350) or from width and height. Like settings.set, the explicit x and y of the items and their keyframes follow the size. Beyond that, text and shape items, and clips with fit none, are scaled by the smaller of the two axis ratios so they keep their share of the frame instead of overflowing it. Clips with fit cover or contain fill the frame by themselves; adjust their crop with clip.set_framing.
name: settings.reframe
summary: Re-targets the project to another aspect ratio and refits the items to the new frame.

background.description: A hex colour, $name from template.colors, or transparent (no background colour; formats with alpha keep it).

description: Sets the given settings. When the size changes, the explicit x and y of every visual item, and the values of its x and y keyframes, are scaled by the ratio of new to old size on each axis; scale and text size are untouched and items at the default position stay centred.
name: settings.set
summary: Sets the frame size, the background colour or the loudness target.

description: Rescales every time quantity q of the project to round(q * new / old), then repairs what rounding can break: durations that became 0, the source range, overlaps, keyframes, caption words, fades and transitions. effective.adjusted lists every item changed by a repair. A rate is 1 to 120 fps with a denominator of 1 or 1001.
name: settings.set_fps
summary: Changes the project frame rate and rescales every time quantity.

duration.description: A length of at least 1 frame.

height.description: Pixels before scale, above 0 and at most 32768.

start.description: a time with a unit: "12.5s", "375f" or "00:00:12.500"

track_id.description: A visual track; omitted, the highest visual track free over the item (an empty track you made for video counts; pass track_id to keep it clear), or a new one on top. effective.track_id names it.

width.description: Pixels before scale, above 0 and at most 32768.

description: Adds a shape item with the given size in pixels before scale. Colours are hex or a template colour name like "$accent"; radius is for rounded_rect only. x and y default to the frame centre.
name: shape.add
summary: Adds a rectangle, rounded rectangle or ellipse to a visual track.

height.description: Pixels before scale, above 0 and at most 32768.

width.description: Pixels before scale, above 0 and at most 32768.

description: Sets the given fields; a value equal to its default clears the stored field. Changing the shape to rect or ellipse removes a stored radius. Position and transform are set with item.set_transform.
name: shape.set
summary: Changes the shape, size, colours, stroke or radius of a shape item.

words.description: For a caption slot: words with times relative to the caption, as lengths.

duration.description: a time with a unit: "12.5s", "375f" or "00:00:12.500"

start.description: a time with a unit: "12.5s", "375f" or "00:00:12.500"

description: Give exactly one of asset_id (media slot), text (text slot) or words (caption slot). A media slot with duration policy fit keeps its duration and needs an asset long enough; with stretch_timeline it takes the rest of the asset and the later items of every track follow.
name: slot.fill
summary: Fills a template slot with media, text or caption words.

item_id.description: A clip, audio, text or caption item.

description: Makes a clip, audio, text or caption item a slot named name; the slot kind follows from the item type (clip and audio give media). Marking the same item again with the same name updates the slot.
name: slot.mark
summary: Marks an item as a template slot.

description: The item keeps its content. An unfilled media slot that still holds the placeholder asset cannot be unmarked.
name: slot.unmark
summary: Removes the slot marking of an item.

colors.description: Name to #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA; null removes the name.

description: Sets the description and adds, replaces or (with null) removes named colours. A colour that a style, a shape or the background still refers to as "$name" cannot be removed. A document that has no template gets one.
name: template.set_info
summary: Sets the description and the named colours of the template.

duration.description: A length of at least 1 frame.

start.description: a time with a unit: "12.5s", "375f" or "00:00:12.500"

text.description: The text; line breaks are allowed.

track_id.description: A visual track; omitted, the highest visual track free over the item (an empty track you made for video counts; pass track_id to keep it clear), or a new one on top. effective.track_id names it.

description: Adds a text item. The style is stored exactly as given, including keys equal to the default. x and y are the centre of the item in pixels; without them the item is centred.
name: text.add
summary: Adds a text item to a visual track.

duration.description: A length, at most the item's duration. Default "0.4s".

item_id.description: A clip, text, caption or shape item.

description: Writes the keyframes (or, for slide_left and slide_right, the transition) of the preset on the in or out edge, 0.4 seconds long unless duration is given. Keyframes of the same properties inside that edge are replaced; the rest of the animation is kept.
name: text.apply_preset
summary: Animates one edge of a visual item with a named preset.

reset_style.description: Empty the stored style before applying style.

style.description: A partial TextStyle, merged; null removes a key.

description: Replaces the text, merges a partial style into the stored one (null removes a key), or empties the style first with reset_style. At least one of text, style and reset_style is required.
name: text.set
summary: Changes the content or the style of a text item.

ripple.description: track (default) or all: all moves later items of every track.

description: Moves the items after the gap earlier by the length of the gap: those of the track (ripple track, the default) or those of every track (ripple all); ripple all also moves the timeline markers after the gap and removes those inside it.
name: timeline.close_gap
summary: Closes the empty range that contains a given frame on a track.

above.description: Place the track directly over this track.

below.description: Place the track directly under this track.

description: Adds a visual or audio track. A visual track goes on top by default and an audio track at the bottom, below the visual ones; position top or bottom, above or below another track places it elsewhere. The first track in the order is the top layer. The document keeps tracks in a map by id, so read the stacking from the order field (ascending, the smallest is the top layer), not from the position of a track in the listing.
name: track.add
summary: Adds an empty track at a place in the track order.

description: Moves a track to the top or the bottom, or directly above or below another track. Items are untouched.
name: track.move
summary: Changes the place of a track in the track order.

with_items.description: Remove the items of the track too.

description: Removes the track. A track with items is refused with E_NOT_EMPTY unless with_items is true, in which case its items are removed too.
name: track.remove
summary: Removes a track, and its items when with_items is true.

replace.description: Replace the whole style instead of merging.

style.description: A partial CaptionStyle; null removes a key when merging.

description: Sets the caption style of a visual track. The style is stored exactly as given, including keys equal to the default. A null value removes a key when merging. highlight is "none" or "word" (the active word is coloured with highlight_color). A bottom position anchors to the bottom of the safe area, not of the frame.
name: track.set_caption_style
summary: Merges a partial caption style into a track, or replaces it.

locked.description: true refuses every edit of the items of the track until it is false again.

magnet.description: true keeps the items of the track packed from frame 0 with no gap, closing the gaps now and after every edit.

solo.description: true plays only the soloed tracks (the picture of visual tracks, the sound of all).

volume.description: Factor on the volume of the items of the track, 0 to 4; 1 is neutral.

description: Sets the given fields. hidden applies to visual tracks, the others to both kinds. locked refuses every edit of the items of the track (E_INVALID_STATE) until it is unlocked. solo plays only the soloed tracks: the picture of visual tracks when one is solo, and the sound of every track. volume is a factor from 0 to 4 on the volume of the items of the track; 1 clears it. magnet packs the items of the track from frame 0 with no gap, now and after every later edit (a locked track is not repacked).
name: track.update
summary: Sets the name, hidden, muted, locked, solo or magnet flag or the volume of a track.
